class Store:
    def param(self) -> str:
        return "?"

    def execute(self, sql: str, params: tuple) -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError


def record_audit(store: Store, event_id: str, action: str, actor: str) -> None:
    store.execute(
        f"""
        INSERT INTO billing_audit_events (id, action, actor_principal)
        VALUES ({store.param()}, {store.param()}, {store.param()})
        """,
        (event_id, action, actor),
    )
